conventions.baseline: mean of -120..-30 min before LP onset, per animal
conventions.peak: max of 2-min rolling-mean dF in [LP onset, +240 min], minus baseline
conventions.trough: min of 2-min rolling-mean dF in [0, +240 min], minus baseline
conventions.note: pulses pooled at different circadian phases: ZT12 (221014 cohort), ZT8 (7390)
